fixture.name: The Legacy Virus
fixture.html:
Setup: 9 Twists. Wound Deck holds 6 Wounds per player.
Twist: Stack this Twist next to the Scheme as a “Virus Mutation.” Then each player reveals a Hero whose cost is greater than the number of Virus Mutations or gains a Wound.
Evil Wins: When the Wound Deck or the Villain Deck runs out.

fixture.name: Replace Earth’s Leaders with Killbots
fixture.html:
Setup: 10 Twists. Stack 1 additional Twist next to this Scheme as a “Killgorithm.”
Special Rules: Bystanders in the Villain Deck are “Killbot” Villains with equal to the number of Killgorithms. They have: “Fight: Rescue this as a Bystander.”
Twists 1-9: Add this Twist to the Killgorithms. Two Killbots enter the city from the Bystander Deck.
Twist 10: All Killbots in the city escape.
Evil Wins: When there are 6 Bystander cards in the Escape Pile.

fixture.name: Secret Invasion of the Skrull Shapeshifters
fixture.html:
Setup: 6 Twists. Always include the Skrull Villain Group. Add an extra Hero to the Hero Deck. Shuffle 4 random cards from the Hero Deck into the Villain Deck.
Special Rules: Hero cards in the Villain Deck and city are “Skrull Infiltrator” Villains with equal to that Hero’s cost +3. They have “Fight: Either KO this card or choose a player to gain it as a Hero.”
Twists 1-5: The leftmost Hero from the HQ enters the Sewers as a Skrull Infiltrator.
Twist 6: All Skrulls in the city escape.
Evil Wins: When there are 6 Hero cards in the Escape Pile.
